task.title: Part 1: Limit of a difference quotient

statement.p: Suppose f(x) = {2x^{2}+8x-5}. Evaluate the limit by using algebra to simplify the difference quotient (in first answer box) and then evaluating the limit (in the second answer box).

task.title: Part 2: Interpreting the limit of a difference quotient

statement.p: The limit of the difference quotient, 0, from Part 1 above is (select all that apply).

li.p: the instantaneous rate of change of f at x = -2.
the slope of the tangent line to the graph of y = f(x) at x = -2.
the slope of the secant line to the graph of y = f(x) at x = -2.
the average rate of change of f at x = -2.
